$$
\text{GCD}\left(\frac{a}{b}, \frac{c}{d}, \frac{e}{f}\right) = \frac{\text{GCD}(a, c, e)}{\text{LCM}(b, d, f)}
$$  
Here, the numerators are $704$, $-759$, and $2683$, while the denominators are $1$, $1$, and $7$. The LCM of the denominators is $\text{LCM}(1, 1, 7) = 7$.

   - $759 - 704 = 55$  
   - $\text{GCD}(704, 55)$: $704 \div 55 = 12$ remainder $44$  
   - $\text{GCD}(55, 44)$: $55 \div 44 = 1$ remainder $11$  
   - $\text{GCD}(44, 11) = 11$  

2. $\text{GCD}(11, 2683)$:  
   - $2683 \div 11 = 243$ remainder $10$  
   - $\text{GCD}(11, 10) = 1$  

Thus, the GCD of the numerators is $1$. Dividing this by the LCM of denominators ($7$) gives the final result:  
$$
